changelog:
Initial release – audit 8D reports, SCARs, and corrective-action reports against VDA and IATF 16949 standards.

- Provides structured compliance audit with detailed findings and actionable recommendations.
- Reviews all 8D sections (D1–D8) based on strict VDA/IATF requirements, emphasizing quantifiable data and clear responsibility assignment.
- Includes extra checks for report formatting, quality tool application, and industry benchmark comparison.
- Outputs findings in a standardized, comprehensive format with summary, itemized issues, gap analysis, and training suggestions.
summary: Audit 8D reports, SCARs, and customer corrective-action reports against VDA and IATF 16949 standards.
